validation_scope: Programmable provenance, exact crop pixels, local synthetic curve-fit error, vector structure, equation aspect ratio, cross-format parse validity, and topology only; not scientific correctness, publication approval, or pixel editability of the two image atoms.

claims.svg: editable native vector composition with two relative replaceable image atoms
claims.pptx: editable native shapes, gradients, text, two independent picture shapes, and vector equations
claims.drawio: editable structural view; pixel equivalence to the SVG/PPTX is not claimed
claims.scientific_correctness: not automated; explicit final researcher approval remains required
